routine — 常规，日常安排

rarely — 很少

usually — 通常
Lin says, 'I usually study in the morning.

improve — 提高，改善
Lin and Maya want to improve their English.

diary — 日记
Lin says, 'I want to learn ten new words every day.' Maya says, 'I am learning to write a diary in English this month.

agree — 同意
I write three sentences every night.' They both agree: a good routine helps.
